metadata.title: Ponnyathankam Cultural Heritage & Historical Sites
metadata.publisher: Ponnyathankam Festival Committee & Kerala Folklore Academy
metadata.compiler: Kadirur Grama Panchayat WebGIS Spatial Information System

properties.name: Ponnyathankam Ankathattu & Festival Arena
properties.description: The world's only permanent traditional Ankathattu (raised combat arena), constructed on 25 cents of land in historic Ponniam Ezharakandam. Venue of the world's largest annual Kalaripayattu festival beginning on Kumbham 9.
properties.historical_event: 16th-century historic duel between Chekavar Thacholi Manikoth Othenan Kurup and Kadirur Mathiloor Gurukkal.
properties.inaugurated_by: Sri Pinarayi Vijayan, Hon. Chief Minister of Kerala
properties.governing_org: Ponnyathankam Committee / Patyam Gopalan Memorial Club / Ponniam Keli
properties.govt_grant: Rs. 8 Crores (Kerala State Budget Project, Culture Dept. & Folklore Academy)

properties.name: Ponniam Ezharakandam Historical Field
properties.description: Historic paddy farming terrain in Ponniam celebrated in the Vadakkan Pattukal ballads as the traditional arena for major martial duels ('Poyth') in medieval Malabar.
properties.historical_event: Site of the 3-day fatal duel (Kumbham 9, 10, 11) between Thacholi Othenan and Kadirur Gurukkal.
properties.govt_grant: Kerala Folklore Academy Protected Heritage Site

properties.name: Pullodi Patyam Gopalan Memorial Reading Room & Club
properties.malayalam_name: പുള്ളോടി പാട്യം ഗോപാലൻ സ്മാരക വായനശാല & ക്ലബ്ബ്
properties.description: Local youth organization and library in Pullodi village that initiated historical research in 2015, coordinated with Kerala Folklore Academy, and mobilized community funding to build the permanent Ankathattu.
properties.historical_event: Revived the historic Ponnyathankam festival in 2015 with 18 cultural organizations under Ponniam Keli.

properties.name: Historic Mathiloor Kalari (Kadirur Gurukkal)
properties.description: Seat of Mathiloor Gurukkal (Kadirur Gurukkal), who trained over 10,000 disciples in Kadirur including Thacholi Othenan. Descendant Kalari schools participating in Ponnyathankam: Gurukripa Kalari Sangham & Gurukulam Kalari Sangham in Pullyod.
properties.historical_event: Ancient center of northern Kalaripayattu instruction in Kadirur.

properties.name: Chundangapoil Ballad Memorial Site
properties.description: Recorded in the Vadakkan Pattukal ballads as the native residence of Mayinkutty, who was hired by Parunthukkal Emman Panicker and shot Thacholi Othenan from an ambush tunnel when Othenan returned to collect his forgotten Kattaram weapon.
properties.historical_event: Ambush of Thacholi Othenan following the victory at Ezharakandam.

properties.name: Kathiroor Suryanarayana Temple
properties.description: Historic 13th-century Sun temple located in Kadirur. One of Kerala's rare ancient temples dedicated to the Sun deity Suryanarayana.
properties.historical_event: 13th-Century temple architecture and central cultural monument of Kadirur.

properties.name: Lokanarkkavu Temple (Vatakara Axis)
properties.description: The historic temple in Vatakara where Thacholi Othenan offered prayers, and where the dispute with Kadirur Gurukkal occurred during the festival, leading to the challenge for the duel at Ponniam Ezharakandam.
properties.historical_event: Origin of the duel challenge between Othenan and Kadirur Gurukkal.
